# WeBuild Co

> Australian AI engineering studio founded by computer engineer Johan Iskandar. We build AI agents — software that runs the repetitive work inside small and mid-sized businesses — scoped with payback math up front, built at a fixed price, run under human supervision until proven, then handed over completely. Owned, not employed. No lock-in, ever.

## What we do
- AI agents that do a defined job the way a team member would: read the incoming work (an email, a lead, a ticket), decide using your rules and knowledge base, act in your actual tools, and log what they did. Not chatbot widgets — workers on workflows.
- Every agent goes through a supervised proving run: it drafts, a human approves, and every miss becomes a fix before go-live. Money, VIPs, and bulk actions always keep a human approval gate.
- Agents run in your infrastructure under your accounts and API keys. Handover includes code, credentials, runbook, and security config — if we part ways, it keeps running and you keep it all.

## How engagements work
- **Foundations Session** — a working session that maps your workflows and does the payback math with your actual numbers. A$300 at the founding rate (A$600–750 standard), credited toward your install.
- **Agent install** — fixed price quoted in writing after scoping, 50% to commence, 50% on handover. Typically 3–4 weeks for a single-workflow agent.
- Running costs after handover: model usage plus tool subscriptions, roughly A$50–300/month for most single-workflow agents — specified before the build.

## Who it's for
Australian small and mid-sized businesses drowning in repetitive admin — re-typing, chasing, after-hours phone — who want to own the system that fixes it. Industries we know: HR & recruiting, migration agents, legal, Islamic finance, Islamic charities, cybersecurity, solar.

## What we build
- What we build (overview): https://www.webuildco.com.au/build/
- Multi-Agent Orchestration — AI agents that run repetitive back-office work end to end (intake, follow-up, data entry, scheduling), supervised until proven: https://www.webuildco.com.au/build/multi-agent-orchestration/
- Command Center — one live view of the business (leads, jobs, cash, capacity, agent activity): https://www.webuildco.com.au/build/command-center/
- Company Brain — company-wide knowledge intelligence plus a librarian agent that keeps knowledge linked and current: https://www.webuildco.com.au/build/company-brain/
- Messaging Integration — agents on iMessage, WhatsApp, and Telegram so clients and staff use the apps they already have: https://www.webuildco.com.au/build/messaging-integration/
- Premium Websites — top Google page-speed scores with SEO and GEO built in, owned by the client: https://www.webuildco.com.au/build/premium-websites/
